go_semantics: Both trees declare go 1.22 in go.mod. The labels assume Go 1.22 language semantics and standard library, built by a Go 1.22 or later toolchain with this module as the main module.

expected_findings.defect: `NewRecorder` never initializes the new `failures` map, so the first `AddFailure` call panics with an assignment to an entry in a nil map.
expected_findings.rationale: A map field of a struct literal that omits it is nil. Reading a nil map is allowed, but `r.failures[name]++` writes to it, which panics at run time.
